_module.description: Physics engine core parameter configuration -- global physics simulation parameters, corresponding to JoltPhysics::PhysicsSettings and PhysicsSystem::Init parameters. Fields listed in requires_restart need a physics thread restart to take effect.

_comment.gravityX: Gravity vector X component (m/s^2), float, any range, default 0.0
_comment.gravityY: Gravity vector Y component (m/s^2), float, any range, default -9.81
_comment.gravityZ: Gravity vector Z component (m/s^2), float, any range, default 0.0
_comment.solverIterations: Velocity solver iterations, int, [1,128], default 10, higher is more accurate but slower, maps to mNumVelocitySteps
_comment.subStepCount: Sub-steps per frame, int, [1,16], default 2, sub-step duration = fixedDeltaTime / subStepCount, maps to Update(dt, collisionSteps, ...)
_comment.maxBodies: Max bodies, int, [1,8388608], default 4096, maps to PhysicsSystem::Init(inMaxBodies)
_comment.maxContactPoints: Max contact points, int, >0, default 10240, exceeding contact points will fall through the world, maps to PhysicsSystem::Init(inMaxContactConstraints)
_comment.maxBodyPairs: Max body pairs, int, >0, default 16384, should be much larger than maxContactPoints, setting to cMaxBodyPairsLimit consumes massive memory, maps to PhysicsSystem::Init(inMaxBodyPairs)
_comment.numBodyMutexes: Number of body mutexes, int, 0(auto) or power of 2 [1,64], default 32, maps to PhysicsSystem::Init(inNumBodyMutexes)
_comment.positionIterations: Position solver iterations, int, [0,16], default 2, corresponds to mNumPositionSteps
_comment.speculativeContactDistance: Speculative contact distance, float, >=0, default 0.02, used for CCD contact prediction
_comment.baumgarte: Baumgarte position correction factor, float, [0,1], default 0.2, controls convergence speed of penetration correction
_comment.timeBeforeSleep: Time before sleep (seconds), float, >=0, default 0.5, body enters sleep after being still for this duration, corresponds to mTimeBeforeSleep
_comment.pointVelocitySleepThreshold: Sleep velocity threshold (m/s), float, >=0, default 0.03, below this velocity the body is considered still
_comment.deterministicSimulation: Deterministic simulation, bool, default true, cross-platform consistent results when enabled
_comment.constraintWarmStart: Constraint warm start, bool, default true, improves constraint solver convergence speed
_comment.allowSleeping: Allow sleeping, bool, default true, when disabled all bodies remain active
_comment.useLargeIslandSplitter: Large island splitter, bool, default true, splits large islands into sub-islands for parallel solving
_comment.linearCastThreshold: CCD trigger threshold (x inscribed radius), float, [0,1], default 0.75, movement exceeding this ratio triggers CCD
_comment.linearCastMaxPenetration: CCD max penetration (x inscribed radius), float, [0,1], default 0.25
_comment.maxPenetrationDistance: Max penetration distance per iteration, float, >=0, default 0.2
_comment.minVelocityForRestitution: Min velocity for restitution (m/s), float, >=0, default 1.0, below this velocity restitution is not applied
_comment.useBodyPairContactCache: BodyPair cache, bool, default true, accelerates repeated contact pair lookup
_comment.useManifoldReduction: Manifold reduction, bool, default true, reduces contact point count for better performance
_comment.checkActiveEdges: Check active edges, bool, default true, detects and removes edges shared by adjacent triangles
_comment.layerConfig: Collision layer config -- defines ObjectLayer/BroadPhaseLayer mapping and collision matrix, see _layerConfig_section notes

_layerConfig_section.objectLayers: ObjectLayer name -> uint16 value mapping, e.g. {"static": 0, "dynamic": 1, "trigger": 2}
_layerConfig_section.broadPhaseLayers: BroadPhaseLayer name -> uint8 value mapping, e.g. {"static": 0, "dynamic": 1}
_layerConfig_section.collisionMatrix: Collision matrix, array, each entry {layerA, layerB, collide}, unlisted pairs default to no collision

_restart_note: Fields listed in requires_restart need a physics thread restart to take effect
